title: Cassiopeia A supernova remnant: 3D reconstruction (volumetric VTK data)
object: Cassiopeia A (supernova remnant with a central neutron star)
source_institution: NASA / Chandra X-ray Center (SAO), MIT; Smithsonian Digitization Program Office
credit: NASA/CXC/SAO; T. Delaney et al. (2010, ApJ 725, 2038)
license: No copyright asserted by the Chandra X-ray Center; used under NASA media guidelines with acknowledgement (https://chandra.harvard.edu/photo/image_use.html)
observatory_instrument: Chandra X-ray Observatory, Spitzer Space Telescope, KPNO 4-m and MDM 2.4-m telescopes (Doppler velocities)
image_kind: 3D reconstruction from Doppler-shift data; iso-surfaces per component (VTK POLYDATA triangle strips)
processing_notes: Components: Si (Chandra), HETG Si, Fe-K (Chandra), Ar/Ne (Spitzer), fast optical knots, Si jets, central compact object.
original_dimensions: 7 VTK surface files, ~143k vertices in total
derivative_operations: At build time tools/bake_casa.py samples every triangle, splats into a 192^3 grid centred on the central compact object, blurs (3 box passes) and normalizes each channel (Si, Fe, IR Ar/Ne, optical+jets) to RGBA8. The result renders iso-surface sheets, not the full emissivity.
intended_use: Ejecta structure of the neutron-star pathway remnant, scaled to the shock radius and ray-marched with a false-colour element key (Si gold, Fe violet-blue, IR green, optical red).
